Scale Army Careers is a remote-first recruiting and talent placement service that matches experienced marketing, sales, and technical professionals outside the U. S.

(primarily Latin America and Africa) with high-growth U. S.

companies. They handle candidate screening (including application forms, video interviews, take-home assignments), contract and payment administration, and provide ongoing support and onboarding guidance while placements work directly with client companies.

Roles are typically full-time remote positions paid in USD through payroll platforms like Deel.
